faq.q: What is the origin of Basir?
faq.a: Basir is associated with Arabic. Baṣīr ('all-seeing, insightful'); al-Baṣīr is one of the divine names. The source record's gloss 'Insightful, having good sense' is a reasonable rendering.
Yes — the underlying form بصير is Arabic.
